_comment: Pinned grype vulnerability DB for the BLOCKING dep-scan path. The blocking CI job imports THIS archive with GRYPE_DB_AUTO_UPDATE=false so a newly-published CVE cannot non-deterministically break an in-flight PR or release — the same posture as pagespeed-optimizer's blocking-dep-scan. Report-only / scheduled runs use the live DB instead, so a new CVE still surfaces within a day, it just does not redden an unrelated PR. To bump: get the current archive from `grype db list -o raw` (or https://grype.anchore.io/databases/v6/latest.json), update path+checksum+built here, re-run the blocking job, and review like any dependency bump. schema/url_base must match the grype version pinned in dep-scan.sh. `max_age_days` is the staleness ratchet — the scheduled dep-scan FAILS once the pin is older than this, so a forgotten pin is loud, not silent. Kept in sync with corp + pagespeed-optimizer tools/sbom/grype-db-pin.json.
